policy: Article length thresholds are warning thresholds, not quotas. An article below the numeric guideline may pass only after explicit manual final-quality review confirms that the search intent, reasons, methods, exceptions, safety conditions, and next actions are complete without padding.

articles.rationale: High-risk action article is intentionally concise. It already explains why flooded roads must not be entered, the decision sequence, common misjudgments, stop conditions, and what to do instead; adding prose only to reach 3000 characters would reduce action clarity.

The article covers the earthquake-insurance system, insured property, insured amount, damage categories, policy-check sequence, enrollment judgment, and post-disaster action without a material explanation gap.

The drinking-water article answers quantity calculation, storage, household differences, rolling stock, expiry management, and review triggers. The remaining gap to the guideline is not a reader-information gap.

The food-stockpile article is only slightly below the guideline and already covers quantity, food selection, no-cook constraints, family conditions, rolling stock, and product-guide routing. Padding is not justified.
